title: Set up VocabX
welcomeText: A couple of minutes of setup and your first card stack is ready. You can change everything later.
nativeHint: Translations will be shown in it.
targetHint: Pick one or more — each has its own progress.
decksHint: Words from the selected decks become your first cards.
noDecks: There are no ready-made decks for these languages yet — you can add words yourself.
checkOfferHint: Mark the words you already know so they skip the new-word queue.
restoreHint: Restore your progress from a file exported from VocabX.
